caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing human figure on a rectangular brown base. The figure is dressed in a red tunic with yellow trim at the collar and blue trim at the hem. It has a green sash tied around the waist and yellow pants or leggings with black shoes. The figure wears a headpiece with three upright green feathers and has long, straight brown hair. The figure's right arm is bent and holds a brown cylindrical object, while the left hand rests on an upright, white cylindrical object with a metal band, positioned to the figure’s left side and attached to the base. The figure's face is painted in a brownish hue, and the drawing is rendered on a plain, cream-colored background with no additional objects or details.
title: Cigar Store Indian
